assumptions: The inner dimension n, block size b, and block count q are positive and satisfy n=q*b.
The block-indexed x and y values are the post-input-conversion values for one scalar dot product in Algorithm 3.1.
The trace starts at state 0 = 0, follows the local rounded recurrence (3.2) for every block, and defines computed as the final state.
The internal, FMA-output, and final-output unit roundoffs are nonnegative, with uBar <= uFma.
The effective output-rounding parameter follows the prioritized cases in equation (3.3).
The relevant gamma denominators are positive.
The local output errors, carry theta factors, and term theta factors satisfy the bounds stated in the derivation of (3.2), including the first-block theta_b adjustment.
Primitive internal errors bounded by uBar are linked to each term's internal operation path; the generic path has length n.
A right-to-left trace has the paper's shorter q+b-1 primitive-error path and one-operation carry bound.
The finite real standard model excludes underflow, overflow, NaNs, and infinities and retains the paper's single modeled output rounding.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P04 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p04_t1_chained_rounding_factor {n b q : ℕ} (run : P04BlockFmaDotRun n b q) : ∃ alpha beta : Fin q → Fin b → ℝ, run.computed = ∑ k : Fin q, ∑ j : Fin b, run.x k j * run.y k j * (1 + alpha k j) * (1 + beta k j) ∧ (∀ k j, |alpha k j| ≤ gamma (p04EffectiveFmaRoundoff run.uBar run.uFma run.uOut) q) ∧ (∀ k j, |beta k j| ≤ gamma run.uBar n) ∧ |p04BlockedDot run.x run.y - run.computed| ≤ p04BlockFmaCoeff (p04EffectiveFmaRoundoff run.uBar run.uFma run.uOut) run.uBar q n * p04BlockedAbsDot run.x run.y ∧ (run.order = P04BlockEvaluationOrder.rightToLeft → (∀ k j, |beta k j| ≤ gamma run.uBar (q + b - 1)) ∧ |p04BlockedDot run.x run.y - run.computed| ≤ p04BlockFmaCoeff (p04EffectiveFmaRoundoff run.uBar run.uFma run.uOut) run.uBar q (q + b - 1) * p04BlockedAbsDot run.x run.y) ∧ (run.uOut ≤ run.uFma ∧ run.uBar = run.uFma → (∀ k j, alpha k j = 0) ∧ |p04BlockedDot run.x run.y - run.computed| ≤ gamma run.uBar n * p04BlockedAbsDot run.x run.y)
formal_statement.plain_language: From every local rounded trace of Algorithm 3.1, construct term-indexed perturbations satisfying the exact mixed-precision factorization and equation (3.4), the q+b-1 right-to-left refinement, and the zero-alpha same-precision reduction.

informal_proof: Inductively unroll recurrence (3.2). Apply the accumulated-product lemma to each suffix of output errors to construct alpha, and to each primitive internal operation path to construct beta. Substitute these factors into the unrolled trace, expand (1+alpha)(1+beta), retain alpha*beta, and bound the absolute finite sum by the exact coefficient in (3.4). Use the q+b-1 primitive path for right-to-left evaluation. Under equal internal/FMA precision and no coarser final rounding, equation (3.3) gives zero effective roundoff, so alpha is zero and the bound reduces to gamma_n(uBar).
informal_statement: The indexed Algorithm 3.1 factorization and absolute dot-product forward-error bound (3.4), including its right-to-left and same-precision consequences.
